quest.title: Compiling the Clues
quest.description: You should be able to make progress with the information you have gathered so far...

talks.objective: Go over the clues with Layla

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text: The time passes as the two of you chat.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Did you infiltrate the House of Daena? And what about those rumors of special powers?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: What's with the Seelie pranking people?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: You're the Seelie, aren't you?

dialogues.speaker: Layla
dialogues.text: Okay, everyone's given us a lot of useful information. Let's go through it and try to organize everything.

dialogues.speaker: Layla
dialogues.text: Some things we heard were pretty straightforward, but others were just ridiculous...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: We should be able to figure out more about its identity and whereabouts.

dialogues.speaker: Layla
dialogues.text: Yeah, let me think and see what I can make of it.

dialogues.speaker: Layla
dialogues.text: (Okay, calm down Layla. I know the info's all over the place, but you can definitely do it.)

dialogues.speaker: Layla
dialogues.text: (First, let's try to figure out the Seelie's identity based on the clues we currently have.)

dialogues.speaker: Layla
dialogues.text: (Then, we'll analyze where it's been sighted and its motives... Finally, we'll piece everything together...)

dialogues.speaker: Layla
dialogues.text: (From there, we should be able to predict its movement. Alright, let's give it a try.)

dialogues.speaker: Layla
dialogues.text: Okay, I think I've got it now...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: So, what've you come up with?

dialogues.speaker: Layla
dialogues.text: First, based on the information Katayoun provided, we can assume that the Seelie is a student from the Rtawahist Darshan.

dialogues.speaker: Layla
dialogues.text: The possibility of it being someone outside the Darshan can be ruled out because it'd be impossible to gain access to those two books without going through the librarian.

dialogues.speaker: Layla
dialogues.text: Next, leaving its crazy abilities aside, all the sightings took place in locations that are officially recommended for astrology observation by the Akademiya.

dialogues.speaker: Layla
dialogues.text: In other words, it's probably just conducting research, and the nature of its research is very similar to mine.

dialogues.speaker: Layla
dialogues.text: The question that I submitted was no simple query, but it was able to give me a reply in just a day. This implies that it's familiar with a similar field of knowledge.

dialogues.speaker: Layla
dialogues.text: So, based on this reasoning, all we have to do is wait for it at the next astrological observation site.

response.speaker: Layla
response.text: Ah, uh... It's nothing, really. There are actually some other factors that I've been speculating about...

response.speaker: Layla
response.text: But that's not important right now, let's get going. Even though we have a lead, it's still hard to say whether we'll be able to make any discoveries.

response.speaker: Layla
response.text: I'll tell you what I mean by that if the Seelie doesn't show up...

choices.text: Look at you, finishing your thesis should be no problem at all.

dialogues.speaker: Layla
dialogues.text: (Hmm... I think it's slowly starting to come together now...)

dialogues.speaker: Layla
dialogues.text: We should be able to see more from up above, but how do we get up there?

dialogues.speaker: Layla
dialogues.text: Let's try using the Elemental Monuments in the area.
